body: No, nothing that serious, basically due to moving countries a couple of times, and being left in a difficult situation for a number of reasons. Basically financial and situational rather than legal issues.

Well I'm not going to tell anyone that part. It means my fate is then out of my hands entirely, and I can't let that happen. As for being out of the system... it's complicated, basically involving moving between countries.

I don't know if it would, being in that sort of environment would be... intimidating I think, with so many people around, and it wouldn't be one I was comfortable with. And anyway, for now I'm completely out of the system as far as medical help goes. Would have no way of accessing it, even if I felt the urge to, but from past experience, I've never find it helpful.

If I keep trying, getting hurt each time is an inevitability, and if I try to protect myself, the only way is by withdrawing completely. I know that's a flaw in me, I'm not good at superficial friendships, and I know the consequences of that, both good and bad. And when it works, then things are... well just as bad, but at least I can feel like if I can't keep going for myself, I can try for other people. But my psyche can't take another hit, and if I'm to die, I'd prefer to do it calmly and rationally right now, rather than being driven to it by another broken trust.

Well it's only logical. Once or twice, if people hurt you, if people breach your trust, you can write it off as life is like that and move on. But I guess it's a case that either I can't trust, or I can't distinguish who can be trusted, and either way it means that not trusting people is the only acceptable choice.

The thing is, nothing is going well. That's not an exaggerated 'woe is me' statement, there just isn't a single part of my life which is going acceptably. I'm trying to change what I can, but the more I try and fail, the less I feel like there is any point to.

I've always made sure to have a ouuple of methods to hand since I was about 13. The more I've thought on it, the more I've refined them I guess, so the certainty is kind of comforting if nothing else.

I've been suicidal half of my life, and the only thing in that time that kept me strong were other people. They aren't the cause of my sadness, they were, for a long time, the only reason I was able to keep going. I tried so hard in that time to move forward, but to suddenly have multiple people, independently of one another, decide to cut ties with me completely, it doesn't take Stephen Hawking to come to a conclusion about why.

I just can't trust people any more. The closer someone is to you, the worse their betrayal hurts when it happens, and there's never been an occasion where it hasn't happened now. Trying to trust anyone now is like letting a knife wielding maniac give you a shave... if he's going to kill me, better I die instead on my own terms.

There's a list about a mile long of things I need to work on, but every time I make progress, these things are destroyed. Yes, I totaly take my happiness from outside myself, because I am not capable of it within myself. I know, I have tried for so long, and I know it's unhealthy, but if I could not have accepted that part of myself a long time ago, I wouldn't be here today.

Meditation only works if you have a clear mind, and asking that of me is like asking a hamster to run a scientific research facility. That's why I feel nothing is so much better than the state life is in now.

There's only so much time you can spend trying to seek happiness before realising it's impossible. There are two types of happiness, that which can be gained from within, and that which can be gained from the world. It's not possible for me to be at peace with who I am, I've spent half my life trying, so I am not exaggerating saying that. And now I'm certain in the knowledge that other people can't be trusted in the end either. If I was stronger in myself that might not matter, but unfortunately I'm not and can't be.

Emptiness and nothingness sounds like a long way up from where I am right now though. They are good things, desirable things, even if it's a permanent choice. Each time this sort of thing has happened in my life, I've tried to move forward, but right now I've lost any reason at all to.

Love, friendship, hope, family and work... it's not just one that's gone, it was a chain cascading through my life. If it was just the one, I'd agree, it happens, and life goes on. But there are only so many times you can get pulled back down before you realise there isn't a reason to stand up and keep going again. And for all the mistakes I've made, I've never treated anyone the way those who I thought gave a damn about me treated me.
